name: Forense de Puntos Clave SIFT
description: Utiliza Scale-Invariant Feature Transform keypoints para detectar duplicated and manipulated image regions.
algorithm: SIFT-Based Copy-Move Forgery Detection with Geometric Verification
mechanism: Extrae SIFT keypoints and descriptors from the image, then matches them to find duplicated regions. Geometric verification using RANSAC eliminates false matches.
parameters: Octaves: 4, Scales: 5, Descriptor: 128-dim, Matching: ratio test (0.6), Verification: RANSAC
source: Amerini, I. et al. (2011) — A SIFT-Based Forensic Method for Copy-Move Attack Detection, IEEE TIFS
useCase: Robust falsificación de copiar-mover detección invariant to scaling, rotation, and iluminación changes

references.title: Amerini, I. et al. (2011) — A SIFT-Based Forensic Method for Copy-Move Attack Detection, IEEE TIFS

strengths:
• Invariante a escala y rotación
• La verificación geométrica reduce falsas coincidencias
• Bien probado en visión por computadora
• Maneja oclusión parcial
limitations:
• Computacionalmente costoso
• Struggles with smooth/textureless regions
• Memory intensive for many keypoints
• Parameter sensibilidad
